_meta.source: earthtojake/text-to-cad benchmarks — the per-benchmark 'Test Cases' tables (MIT).
_meta.checks: Auto-checkable subset only: solids (fused-body count), bbox_mm (overall size, tol=max(2mm,5%) per axis), min_holes (>= count of requested holes/bores, verified via cylindrical-face count). null = not deterministically checkable (skipped, not failed). Location/fillet/angular criteria from the upstream tables are NOT auto-scored here. | min_through_holes: holes that must pass fully through (blind bore detected via axis point-membership in scripts/inspect).
_meta.scoring: score = passed_non_null_criteria / total_non_null_criteria, per benchmark and overall.
